thread:
Jo: Quick heads-up from a docs QA pass: we have inconsistent pluralization and hyphenation for the concept around model variants. Examples: 'model variant', 'model variants', 'model-variant', and 'variants' are all used. This is confusing in the glossary and migration guide.
Ken: Agree. For clarity I think we should pick canonical forms for: code/config, glossary ID, and prose. My proposal: glossary ID = `model-variant` (param-case), code/config keys use `model-variant`, and prose use 'model variant' or 'model variants' naturally.
Maya: Sounds good. Also found several SDK examples using camelCase `variantId` and a few docs using plain 'variant' (ambiguous). Those camelCase snippets break the snippet linter.
Jo: Example I saw in /docs/migrate/variants.md:
```
# current
client.rollout(variantId='v1')

# preferred
client.rollout({'model-variant': 'v1'})
```
Ken: We should add a short migration snippet block in that guide showing before/after. I'll draft a tiny patch.
Ishan: I'll add a one-line rule to /docs/style.md under 'naming': "Use param-case for config keys and inline code (e.g., `model-variant`). Use natural prose for descriptions (e.g., 'model variant' or 'model variants')." Also adding a PR-template checkbox: "Parameter naming follows docs style (param-case)."
Maya: I'll sweep the open PRs I own and replace `variantId`/`modelVariant` with `model-variant` in code blocks. I'll leave prose untouched unless it's awkward.
DocsBot: note: docs-snippet-test flagged 6 snippets with `variantId` and 2 pages where 'model-variant' is missing from glossary aliases.
Jo: Let's also add aliases to the glossary entry so search finds 'variant', 'variant id', 'variantId', and 'model variant'. That will reduce churn for readers.
Ken: I'll open the glossary PR with aliases and a short description: "A model variant is a deployed version of a model (e.g., v1, v2) used for routing, canarying, and rollouts."
Ishan: I'll add a small CI grep to catch `\bvariantId\b|\bmodelVariant\b` in docs/snippets to fail early. Short PR only.
Maya: Plan: (1) Ken PR: glossary aliases + migration snippet, (2) Maya PRs: snippet fixes in owned PRs, (3) Ishan PRs: style.md blurb + PR template checkbox + CI grep. Quick review afterwards.
Jo: If we merge these today, please run the docs-snippet-test job full run to catch any remaining instances. :thumbsup:
DocsBot: queued: docs-snippet-test (post-merge run).
Ken: I'll post PR links here once ready.
Maya: Starting sweeps now.
Ishan: Drafting style PR next.
Jo: Thanks team — small set of changes but will improve search and reduce linter noise.
